title: Cloud event: plan made on forecast, replayed on actuals
description: At 11:30, just after a passing cloud (10:30–11:45), the HistGradientBoosting forecaster sees depressed recent output: its P50 predicts a safe feeder, so the P50-based plan is 'no action'. When the cloud clears, actual PV returns to full and the frozen plan fails on actuals. The P90 forecast did flag the risk.
parameter_rationale: pv_multiplier 48: above first_violation_mult (42) so clear-sky actuals violate; cloud ends before the horizon; model hgb trained leave-one-day-out
